description: Which held positions have no working stop order covering them, from pasted positions and open-orders exports: each row critical, warning, ok or unchecked, with the reason. Same engine as stop_coverage_check. Example questions: "Do all my positions have stop losses?"; "Which stocks am I holding with no stop?"; "Did my stop orders expire?"

orders_csv.description: Open orders as CSV text, or "none"

positions_csv.description: The positions/portfolio CSV from the broker, pasted as text (symbol, quantity, market value or last price; a gain or cost-basis column for gains and losses)

name: positions_without_stop_loss
title: Positions Without a Stop Loss
